candidates.change_summary: Replace the owner assignment with setting owner to address(0), so after owned() completes owner is zero instead of msg.sender.
Invert the access-control check so only non-owners can execute owned(), letting an attacker's owned() call set owner to their address.
Delete the statement `totalSupply -= _value;` so burning tokens no longer decreases totalSupply.
Replace `totalSupply -= _value;` with `totalSupply += _value;` so burning increases totalSupply instead of decreasing it.
Replace `totalSupply -= _value;` with `totalSupply = _value;` so burning sets totalSupply to the burned amount instead of subtracting from it.
Replace `totalSupply -= _value;` with `totalSupply -= 1;` so burning decreases totalSupply by a fixed 1 instead of by _value.
Delete the require so a burn larger than the balance still decrements totalSupply (and underflow-reverts), changing when totalSupply updates occur.
Delete the balance decrement so burn reduces totalSupply but leaves balanceOf unchanged.
Change the balance update from subtraction to addition so burn credits the caller's balance instead of debiting it.
Insert a credit of the burned amount to the zero address, changing balanceOf at key address(0).
Change the balance check from >= to > so burning the entire remaining balance reverts instead of zeroing the caller's balance.
Delete the require in onlyOwner so any caller can invoke burn, allowing non-owners to change balanceOf at arbitrary keys.
Replace the assignment with `frozenAccount[target] = true;` so freezing with `false` no longer unfreezes the account.
Replace the assignment with `frozenAccount[target] = !freeze;` so the freeze flag is inverted.
Delete the state-update statement so freezeAccount never modifies frozenAccount.
Insert an additional assignment that also sets frozenAccount for the caller's address, so an extra key becomes frozen.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any address can freeze/unfreeze accounts.
Invert the onlyOwner check so only non-owners may call owner-only functions like freezeAccount, while the owner's calls revert.
